masterpiece, best quality, score_7, safe, year 2025, newest,
A young woman with long, wavy ash-blonde hair tied loosely at the nape of her neck and pale green eyes stands in the doorway of an overgrown greenhouse at dusk. She wears a cream-colored knit cardigan over a dark pleated skirt, a leather satchel on her right shoulder. Her left hand rests on the doorframe, her right hand holds a small brass watering can. Behind her, ferns and ivy spill from cracked terracotta pots. A broken pane in the glass roof lets warm orange light fall diagonally across the floor, catching dust in the air.

masterpiece, best quality, score_7, safe, year 2025, newest,
A young woman stands in the doorway of an old greenhouse at dusk. She has long, wavy ash-blonde hair tied loosely at the nape of her neck, with a few strands falling across her face, and pale green eyes. She wears a cream-colored knit cardigan over a dark pleated skirt, and a leather satchel hangs from her right shoulder. Her left hand rests on the doorframe; her right hand holds a small brass watering can. The greenhouse behind her is overgrown: ferns and ivy spill from cracked terracotta pots, and a broken pane in the glass roof lets a shaft of warm orange light fall diagonally across the floor, catching the dust in the air. The camera is at eye level, framing her from the knees up, slightly off-center to the left, with the greenhouse receding into soft focus behind her. The mood is quiet and slightly melancholic, like the last warm hour before the light goes.
